about.title: About me
about.bio: I'm Enrique Such Andreu, a Digital Technology and Multimedia graduate from UPV, with part of the Master's in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Bologna taken as an Erasmus+ student. I work in Rankia's Product & Tech team, building web applications and generative AI tools. My degree mixes the technical and the creative: programming, computer vision, 3D and virtual reality.
